sections.shortTitle: N -W F P District Development Advisory Committees Amendment Act 1999
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVI OF 1999
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEES (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1999
ACT XVI OF 1999
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Establishment of District Development
Advisory Committees Act, 1989
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 13th October, 1999]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis:I/99/24255,
dated 13-10-1999.--The North- West Frontier Province District Development
Advisory Committees (Amendment) Bill, 1999, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on the 28th September, 1999
and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 7th
October, 1999, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
District Development Advisory Committees (Amendment) Act, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

ACT XVI OF 1999
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEES (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1999
ACT XVI OF 1999
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Establishment of District Development
Advisory Committees Act, 1989
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 13th October, 1999]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis:I/99/24255,
dated 13-10-1999.--The North- West Frontier Province District Development
Advisory Committees (Amendment) Bill, 1999, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on the 28th September, 1999
and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 7th
October, 1999, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North-West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 2 of
N.-W.F.P. Act No. IV of 1989.--In the North-West Frontier Province
Establishment of District Development Advisory Committees Act, 1989 (N.-W.F.P.
Act No.IV of 1989), in section 2 in clause (g) for the word
"Divisional", the word "Assistant" and for the word "Division",
the word "District" shall be substituted.
